variant_decisions.evidence: ASV renders the clause passively: 'nor shall the first-fruits of the land be alienated'. A passive with the first-fruits as its subject requires a transitive verb governing them as object, which is the hiphil qere yaavir ('cause to pass over', i.e. transfer ownership); the ketiv qal yaavor is intransitive ('pass over/away') and would put the first-fruits in the subject of an active 'shall not pass', which the ASV does not give. The transfer-of-ownership sense of 'alienated' likewise answers the causative.
